products.title: Suit Up Trouser (Regular) - Gravel
products.body_html: She’s iconic for a reason. The Suit Up Trouser is the cool-girl silhouette your closet has been missing. This style has a regular-length inseam for figures 5’7” and under. It has a loose, relaxed fit that’s oh-so flattering and features front pleats that add a tailored touch to any look. Pair it with your favorite top, and you’ll be ready for anything.

Pair it with your favorite tee, tank, or bra, and you’re ready to serve.
